source_value.trigger: Pointer interaction inside the recording: a hover action row appears at the right edge of one timeline message from about 8s, and the message column then scrolls down beginning at 9.58s.
source_value.start_state: media/state-01.png at 4.5s: the incident channel is open, one row in the dark purple sidebar is a filled blue band, and the message column shows four app-posted timeline entries with red square avatars, the last of them a bordered card carrying labelled rows and two button-like controls.
source_value.end_state: media/state-05.png at 11s: the same window with the message column scrolled down, the entry that was mid-column now near the top, two further app-posted entries revealed at the bottom, one of them a grey quoted block with a left border, and a second grey pill added beside the channel title.
source_value.continuity: Continuous inside one window. The sidebar, the channel header and the composer stay in place while only the message column changes. Sampled at 12 fps from 8.5s, the column is unchanged through the 9.500s frame, shifts between the 9.500s and 9.583s frames, shifts again between the 10.000s and 10.083s frames, and is byte-identical from the 10.833s frame to the 11.000s frame.
source_value.feedback: The selected channel row in the sidebar stays a filled blue band in all five stills; in media/state-04.png the message under the pointer carries both a grey background band and an action row of small icons at its right end; app-posted entries are marked by a red square avatar and a separate short badge beside the author name.
source_value.reduced_motion_equivalent: The outcome of the motion persists statically: media/state-05.png alone shows the scrolled position and the two later timeline entries, so a reader who never sees the scroll still reaches the later evidence.
